The <b>Hunter's Memento</b> is a [[Materium#Mementos|Memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
The memento can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]] after interacting with the desk.

It appears in the center of the shelving slots.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Nuu]] after completing the 230 required entries in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] in <abbr title="The default game mode.">Classic Mode</abbr> (or 231 in {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]).

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Hunter's Journal.png!Location of Nuu in [[Greymoor]]
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Greymoor 06.png!Nuu inside Halfway Home in Greymoor
}}

{{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} [[Summoned Saviour]] is a boss unique to Steel Soul Mode and accounts for the extra entry required to acquire the Hunter's Memento in Steel Soul Mode.

The following entries are not required in order to acquire the Hunter's Memento:

<div style="text-align:top; columns:2">
* [[Flintbeetle]]
* [[Palestag]]
* [[Shakra]]
* [[Garmond and Zaza]]
* [[Lost Garmond]]
* [[Lost Lace]]
</div>

== Achievement ==
{{Achievements|allgames=silksong|True Hunter}}

== Trivia ==
* The Hunter's Memento is marked with the same symbol as the [[Hunter's Mark]] from <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>.
* An older design of the Hunter's Memento exists within game files.
